enumerate:  Θ(F × P × membership-scan) plus export-map work
references: Θ(Σd∈E [P + Σp∈C(d) (S(p) + R(d,p))])
dedupe:     Θ(Σd references(d)) space, plus O(Ud log Ud) sort per declaration
